• We identify and correct a suboptimality in weight-              metric calibration mechanism that propagates prior-layer
   compensation methods by deriving a closed-form cor-            output deviations as a residual to align each layer’s quan-

3.3. GPTQ
GPTQ [11] extends the framework of OBQ [12], inherit-
ing its Hessian optimization strategy while introducing key
innovations that enable practical large-scale deployment.
OBQ addresses the problem of compressing floating-point
model weights w into low-bit integer codes ŵ by minimiz-
ing the layer-wise output discrepancy:
  min ||(w + ∆w)X − wX||2F , s.t. ∆w = ŵ − w, (4)
      ∆w

tized layer. For each weight coordinate q, OBQ identifies
the best quantized level and corresponding compensation
